ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Attempt Via Existing Service Tampering
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the modification of an existing service in order to execute an arbitrary payload when the service is started or killed as a potential method for persistence.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*sc\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*config\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*binpath\\=.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*sc\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*failure.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*command\\=.*"))) OR (((process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*FailureCommand.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ImagePath.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bin\\$.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.js.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.msh\\$.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.reg\\$.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.scr.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ps.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vb.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jar.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pl.*")))
